description: Blocks the orchestrator from dispatching a non-trivial subagent in the FOREGROUND — a foreground subagent blocks the main thread until it finishes, defeating orchestration. Allows `run_in_background: true`, trivial one-liner dispatches, and subagent-made dispatches (agent_id present). Escape hatch: ALLOW_FOREGROUND_SUBAGENT=1 + ALLOW_FOREGROUND_SUBAGENT_REASON='why'. on_error=open: orchestration discipline, not a security boundary.
